summary: FROST's film-poster specimen for Calhern, a 78-style grotesk from Condensed to Wide (named after actor Louis Calhern): a pinned, skippable scroll-driven title sequence, film posters with a hover style inspector, pointer-driven axis tiles, a movie-poster editor with style pickers, colour and image upload, editable credit-block samples, a sticky technical sidebar with glyph metrics and a trial sign-up. The capture stops at 30000px; everything after the VHS strip was read from the HTML, the video and the mobile capture.

instances.look: White on black, like film opening titles: 'CALHERN' in condensed black caps filling the width; then 'A / TYPEFACE / OF / EXTREMES' builds word by word in a centred stack (the 'A' thinning to a hairline skeleton); a single 'A' swells from condensed to a huge wide black 'A'; corner captions appear in wide caps ('TYPEFACE BY FROST', '78 STYLES 13 WEIGHTS +ITALICS', 'CONDENSED STANDARD WIDE'); finally a film billing block ('STARRING STERLING HAYDEN AND LOUIS CALHERN … DIRECTED BY JOHN HUSTON') sits under the A
instances.ux: Pinned for ~11 screens of scroll; a thin progress line grows along the bottom with 'SKIP INTRO'; a scroll prompt icon at first; the fixed 'A TYPEFACE BY FROST' / 'BUY CALHERN' bar stays on top
instances.learn: Stage the family's range as an opening-credits sequence scrubbed by scroll, with a 'Skip intro' progress bar so impatient visitors can jump straight to the content

reconstruction.layout: Pinned 100vh stage; wordmark ~1400px wide × ~350px cap height centred; word stack centred ~130px per line; giant 'A' up to ~1300px wide; corner captions 3 lines each at top-left, top-centre, top-right ~40px from edges; progress bar 1px line at bottom-left (width % of progress) with 'SKIP INTRO' at its end
reconstruction.typography: Wordmark ~432px FT Calhern Condensed Black caps; stack words ~100px Condensed (Regular→Black, the A from Skeleton to Black); captions ~22px FT Calhern Wide Black caps, tight leading; billing block condensed caps ~10–14px in film-credit style; UI ~11px caps

reconstruction.content: Name, 'A typeface of extremes', style counts and a film billing block referencing The Asphalt Jungle (John Huston, Louis Calhern)
